div.div:
Default security group: DO NOT USE
Every VPC comes with one. Ours has every rule removed, so anything accidentally placed in it can't talk to anything.

div.div:
Two layers, two jobs.
A security group guards one resource and remembers who it let in, so replies flow back. The network ACL guards the whole subnet and checks traffic in both directions, every time.
